scope: Product build, test, and deployment inputs; bootstrap agent tools retain their separate locks.

policy.promotion: Candidate inputs may be used for gated isolated preparation. Runtime admission and release promotion require the applicable E01/E06/E07 evidence; this inventory does not grant them.
policy.upstream_bundle_rule: Update native clients as stable source bundles. Preserve their own go.mod/go.sum and replacements until separately reviewed integration. A transitive prerelease or pseudo-version already in a bundle is not an independently selected prerelease.

generated_outputs.description: Record project patch commits, build inputs, image index/platform digests, and each native profile's evidence.
Build or package exact upstream supporting binaries and record image digests, provenance, and dedicated L1 instance bindings.
Record Gateway, test reader, driver, and helper source/dependency/image locks after their owning implementation tasks produce them.
Resolve each build's actual module graph and checksums, including project integration. Upstream go.sum inputs may contain unused versions and are not this closure.
Verify signed indexes, resolve complete per-platform build/runtime package closures, and pin compression/system libraries actually linked.
Materialize all seven identity/genesis/fork/bootstrap manifests, source hashes, and native parse proofs. Heimdall genesis payloads and testnet-specific sources still need acquisition.
Pin contract source, compiler, EVM target, bytecode/ABI, deployment inputs, and independent expectations per applicable profile/fork.

Implement scripts/refresh-versions check/update, source failures, compatible resolution, UpdateReport, full affected gates, and atomic promotion. This inventory and offline validator are not that updater.
